delivery_templates.name: 研究Brief与决策问题
delivery_templates.acceptance: 范围、受众、市场、决策与不能回答的问题明确
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Scope, audience, markets, decision and non-answerable questions are explicit

delivery_templates.name: 指标字典与问卷映射
delivery_templates.acceptance: 每个KPI包含题号、分子、分母、Base、单位与用途
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Every KPI has a question ID, numerator, denominator, base, unit and use

delivery_templates.name: 问卷、题号与逻辑草案
delivery_templates.acceptance: 题号、选项、Base、跳转、随机化和预计时长完整
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Question IDs, options, bases, routing, randomization and expected length are complete

delivery_templates.name: 样本与配额方案
delivery_templates.acceptance: 总体精度、主配额、软配额、加样和分组Base边界明确
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Overall precision, primary and soft quotas, boosts and subgroup-base limits are explicit

delivery_templates.name: 分析、模型与验证计划
delivery_templates.acceptance: 主模型、辅助模型、结果变量、留出方式和降级规则明确
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Primary and supporting models, outcomes, holdouts and downgrade rules are explicit

delivery_templates.name: 问卷程序与上线检查
delivery_templates.acceptance: 全路径测试、配额动作、设备适配与数据落点通过
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: All paths, quota actions, devices and data landing points pass testing

delivery_templates.name: 配额与数据质量监控
delivery_templates.acceptance: 按日查看完成量、配额偏差与异常样本
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Daily completion, quota variance and anomalous respondents are monitored

delivery_templates.name: 匿名化Raw Data与数据字典
delivery_templates.acceptance: 主键唯一、变量完整、值域和路由一致
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Keys are unique; variables, value ranges and routing are complete

delivery_templates.name: 加权KPI、Table与分组结果
delivery_templates.name_en: Weighted KPIs, tables and subgroup results
delivery_templates.acceptance: 总体与分组数字可复算，Base和显著性口径一致
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Overall and subgroup results reproduce with consistent bases and significance rules

delivery_templates.name: 模型结果、系数与诊断
delivery_templates.acceptance: 系数、区间、误差、校准与适用边界同时交付
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Coefficients, intervals, error, calibration and scope limits ship together

delivery_templates.name: 决策Dashboard与洞察页面
delivery_templates.acceptance: 结论回答业务问题并能追溯至证据
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Findings answer the business question and trace back to evidence

delivery_templates.name: 跨期字段与KPI复算
delivery_templates.name_en: Cross-wave field map and KPI recomputation
delivery_templates.acceptance: 同口径重算；差异与断点有记录
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Comparable definitions are recomputed and breaks are documented

delivery_templates.name: 下一期回测与模型更新
delivery_templates.acceptance: 报告预测误差、区间覆盖、分群误差与更新决定
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Forecast error, interval coverage, segment error and update decisions are reported

delivery_templates.name: 真实结果校准与行动复盘
delivery_templates.acceptance: 区分意向、选择实验与真实购买/销售结果
delivery_templates.acceptance_en: Intent, experimental choice and observed purchase or sales are separated

research_checkpoints.name: 业务问题与指标口径复核
research_checkpoints.value: 防止模型回答一个与客户决策相邻但不同的问题
research_checkpoints.value_en: Prevents the model from answering a question adjacent to, but different from, the client decision

research_checkpoints.name: 问卷、逻辑与消费者语言复核
research_checkpoints.value: 确保题目可理解、可作答并能进入明确指标
research_checkpoints.value_en: Ensures questions are understandable, answerable and mapped to defined metrics

research_checkpoints.name: 样本、配额与权重复核
research_checkpoints.value: 保证总体与关键人群比较有足够Base且不夸大交叉结果
research_checkpoints.value_en: Protects adequate bases for total and priority segments without overstating cross-cells

research_checkpoints.name: 模型、洞察与行动复核
research_checkpoints.value: 把系数和诊断转成有证据、有边界的客户决策
research_checkpoints.value_en: Turns coefficients and diagnostics into bounded, evidence-backed decisions

method_sources.title: AI-Enabled Consumer Intelligence Platform
method_sources.adapted_principle: 问卷、社媒与行为信号并列验证；不把单一信号当作完整消费者事实
method_sources.adapted_principle_en: Triangulate survey, social and behavioral signals rather than treating one source as the whole consumer truth

method_sources.title: BASES Product Testing
method_sources.adapted_principle: 把历史产品知识、消费者测试、模型与上市结果校准连接起来
method_sources.adapted_principle_en: Connect historical product knowledge, consumer tests, models and launch outcomes

method_sources.title: Kantar Marketplace
method_sources.adapted_principle: 先按业务任务路由到概念、包装、价格、广告或追踪方案
method_sources.adapted_principle_en: Route the business task first to concept, pack, pricing, advertising or tracking

method_sources.title: Quotas
method_sources.adapted_principle: 把简单配额、交叉配额、完成状态和超配处理纳入上线检查
method_sources.adapted_principle_en: Include simple and cross quotas, completion status and over-quota handling in launch checks
